description: This file defines an interface class ISharedMemoryHandle within the firebolt::rialto::client namespace. The class provides a pure virtual method getShm() for accessing shared memory, and includes standard constructors and destructors. It serves as an abstraction for shared memory handle management in the Rialto client component.

classes.name: ISharedMemoryHandle
classes.description: An interface class for managing shared memory handles, providing a method to access the shared memory pointer.

methods.name: getShm
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the shared memory segment.
